source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Two points that I think should finalize the power board:
1\. Add a 2-pin JST-GH connector (J\_PWR\_BTN) for a panel-mounted momentary button connected to the AXP2101 PWRON pin. Pressing it while the system is off turns it on, and pressing it while on turns it off.
2\. For the DCDC1 output, configure AXP2101 DCDC1 to 3.4V rather than 3.3V through I2C. This compensates for the Schottky diode drop in the main-board power OR-ing circuit and keeps the 3.3V rail at the correct voltage under all conditions.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: The power board is no problem, so could you instead add a 2-pin JST-GH connector to the main board for a panel-mounted power button? PWRON already arrives through J\_PWR\_SIG pin 4; the new connector only needs to tap that line so a button can be wired from the enclosure panel.
